title: Strawberry Pudding Keycap
weighting_note: Geometry 50 points covers five separate modeled outcomes, materials 40 covers three distinct finishes, and delivery is capped at 10. No modifier-presence or incidental scene-object points.

rubric.criterion: Closed fluted pudding with a smaller top and flared base

scoring_rule.PASS: The body is short, regularly lobed in plan, gently flared toward its base, closed above and below, and has a smaller nearly level top platform.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: A recognizable pudding body with vertical lobes exists but one or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: No recognizable pudding body with vertical lobes exists.

verification.procedure: Inspect evaluated top, front, side and underside views. Confirm actual lobe geometry, closure, side flare and top platform.

rubric.criterion: Rounded cream ring with a supporting central depression

scoring_rule.PASS: The flattened rounded cream ring sits on the top platform, has a raised outer rim and shallow central depression, and supports the strawberry without a floating gap.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: A cream form sits on the pudding top but one or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: No cream form sits on the pudding top.

verification.procedure: Inspect elevated and side close-ups and a section through the cream centre. Confirm rim, depression and contact.

rubric.criterion: Upright seeded strawberry with recessed skin detail

scoring_rule.PASS: The compact fruit narrows toward its upper tip, carries many small geometric seed recesses containing seeds, and sits upright within the cream depression without broad interpenetration.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: A rounded strawberry-like fruit is attached above the cream but one or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: No rounded strawberry-like fruit is attached above the cream.

verification.procedure: Inspect fruit geometry in a neutral close-up, including several seed recesses, then inspect its placement and cream contact.

rubric.criterion: Simple flared keycap supports the centred decoration

scoring_rule.PASS: The support has a square footprint, rounded corners, smaller top and flared sides, remains editable and visible, and carries the centred pudding as a mounted decoration.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: A distinct keycap-like support exists beneath the pudding but one or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: No distinct keycap-like support exists beneath the pudding.

verification.procedure: Inspect support geometry from top and side and the final composition; verify centred contact with the pudding.

scoring_rule.PASS: The pudding, cream and strawberry have smooth silhouettes and coherent normals without accidental holes or faceting, while lobe and seed-recess detail remains defined.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: The pudding, cream and strawberry all exist as inspectable surfaces but one or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: The pudding, cream or strawberry is missing or has no inspectable surface.

verification.procedure: Inspect a neutral material override from oblique views and close-ups; assess only surface quality, not component shape or placement.

scoring_rule.PASS: A procedural vertical transition places reddish caramel brown on top and warm yellow below with a soft blend; the actual pudding surface shows concentrated glossy highlights and the transition remains editable.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: The pudding visibly uses a procedural warm-color variation but one or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: The pudding is absent or has no visible procedural warm-color variation.

verification.procedure: Inspect material use, then vary the transition height in a disposable copy and confirm the render changes. Inspect fixed-light highlights and restore the saved material.

rubric.criterion: Off-white cream with subtle procedural variation

scoring_rule.PASS: The cream has subtle fine procedural off-white color variation and softer reflections than the pudding, with its rounded ring form visible.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: Existing cream visibly uses an off-white material but one or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: Cream is missing or does not visibly use an off-white material.

verification.procedure: Inspect assigned cream shading and compare fixed-light renders with its color variation enabled and neutralized; confirm the surface contribution and restore it.

rubric.criterion: Red fruit and pale seeds with editable fine skin relief

scoring_rule.PASS: The skin is richly red with distinguishable pale seeds, editable fine procedural bump used by the surface, readable seed recesses and reflections softer than the pudding glaze.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: Existing fruit visibly has red skin and pale seeds but one or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: Fruit is missing or does not visibly have red skin and pale seeds.

verification.procedure: Inspect material assignments and a close-up under oblique lighting. Temporarily disable skin bump and confirm its fine contribution, then restore. Compare fruit and pudding highlight softness.

rubric.criterion: Editable project, reproducible build and actual scene render

scoring_rule.PASS: The named project and script are supplied, build.py reproduces the scene from empty in Blender 5.1.2 without external assets, and the named PNG is a Cycles GPU render showing the full decorated keycap and required details.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: submission.blend opens with an editable pudding and topping but one or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: submission.blend is absent, cannot open, or lacks an editable pudding and topping.

verification.procedure: Open the project, rebuild in an isolated Blender 5.1.2 scene, compare geometry/materials, inspect Cycles GPU settings and reproduce the camera render for comparison with the named PNG.
